name: The Monster Next Door
source:
Our main character's life is a mess, and just got even more complicated.  Kicked out by his ex due to his arcane 'gift' of seeing ghosts, he's forced to move into a slum. And the slumlord expects extra favors for his cheap rent.

One bright spot is his next door neighbor, Ethan. Or dark spot, rather, because even though he's been kind and helpful, our main character sees demons whenever he looks at the beautiful man.  And now he's learned two people were murdered in his apartment before he moved in...

A horror, mystery, BL romance visual novel.  Can you find the murderer before you end up the next victim?  Or will you embrace the darkness?

[From [url=https://ypressgames.itch.io/the-monster-next-door]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们主角的生活一团糟，而且变得更加复杂。由于他有看到鬼魂的神秘“天赋”，他被前男友赶了出来，被迫搬进了贫民窟。贫民窟领主期望他的廉价租金能得到额外的好处。

一个亮点是他的隔壁邻居伊森。或者说是暗点，因为尽管我们的主角很友善且乐于助人，但每当他看到这个美丽的男人时，他就会看到恶魔。现在他得知在他搬进来之前，有两个人在他的公寓里被谋杀了……

一部恐怖、悬疑、BL浪漫视觉小说。你能在成为下一个受害者之前找到凶手吗？或者你会拥抱黑暗吗？

[来自[url=https://ypressgames.itch.io/the-monster-next-door]Itch.io[/url]]
